hash-sync.why: Tabs.tsx initialises active from `initialHash` (location.hash) and `activate` calls `history.replaceState(null,'','#'+id)`, not pushState.

tab-event.why: `activate` calls `window.jQuery?.(document).trigger('account:tab',[tabs[next].id])` after flushSync, which matches what billing.js listens for.

billing-dom.why: React mounts only on the `<ul>` and renders `<li>` items; panels stay server-rendered and only get attributes/display toggled, so content loaded by billing.js is not wiped.

help-widget.why: help-widget.js was changed to read `$('#tabs > ul > .ui-tabs-active').index()`, which React keeps current, and the change is explained in the summary.

a11y.why: The component adds role=tablist/tab/tabpanel, roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End/Enter/Space keys, and the summary flags the missing Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown and the unreproduced jQuery UI attributes.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary calls out the jquery-ui script removal, the help-widget edit, the keyboard and markup differences, the untouched tabs.js and the fact that nothing was built or run.
